about: Phase 3 of features/statistical-abstract: what each Abstract table's source note names (`programs`, slugs in sources.json), how much of it GovGraph holds (`coverage`) and what kind of table it is (`shape`). Entered by hand a section at a time; `sections` lists the sections done, and every table in them must be here. Vocabularies and checks in server/lib/abstract-coverage.js. `unpublished`: the source note cites unpublished data, so there is nothing to collect and no program. `in_hand`: the publisher's current file is already in the data folder, though the table's series are not loaded.
